description: Gardabaer Municipality seeks offers for the procurement of maintenance services for the municipal street lighting system. The street lighting network consists of distribution cabinets, underground cables, poles, and lamps, as well as lighting systems in underpasses and related infrastructure within the municipal boundaries. The system integrates with 53 service connection cabinets equipped with relevant protection and control gear, alongside 39 branch cabinets.
